user.title: Pstryk OSD Compare
user.description: Enter your Pstryk API key (Pstryk app → settings → API). You can reuse the same key as in Pstryk AiO.

source.title: DSO / meter data source
source.description:
Choose a discovered Tauron AMIplus meter, or point to hourly statistics manually.

If nothing is listed: install [Tauron AMIplus]({tauron_url}) via HACS, enable generation + balanced + store statistics, wait for the first poll, then retry.

custom_stats.title: Custom hourly statistics
custom_stats.description: Select long-term statistics (sum) for grid import and export. Balanced series are optional.

contract.title: Pstryk contract period
contract.description: Comparison runs only inside this period. Suggested start from API: {suggested}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Pstryk API key was rejected. Enter a valid key.

error.invalid_contract_dates: Contract end must be after start; start cannot be in the future

init.title: Pstryk OSD Compare options
init.description: Adjustments: JSON object mapping "YYYY-MM" to PLN. Official invoices: JSON object mapping "YYYY-MM" to an object with invoice, deposit_used, bonus, inflow, number (easier: the FV form entities). Settlement day: before that day the app shows deposit through M−2, then through M−1.

fv_no_invoice.message: Enter the gross invoice amount before saving.

dso_stale.title: No fresh DSO data for {meter}
dso_stale.description:
The last hour with DSO (Tauron) statistics is {last} — more than {days} days old. Deposit and Δ values stop at that point.

Check the Tauron AMIplus integration (login, eLicznik availability, `store statistics` enabled). This warning disappears automatically after the next successful sync.
